column1: 1. Members: one row per member (admins and owner excluded). Names are anonymized placeholders for the demo.
2. Join date comes from Skool. Renewal date is the next anniversary of the join date and rolls forward each year.
3. Status turns Red if not active in Skool 14+ days or no contact from you in 21+ days; Yellow if inactive 7 to 13 days or renewal within 30 days; Green otherwise.
4. Touchpoints: log every DM, call or check-in (pick the member from the dropdown). 'Last contact' on Members fills itself from here.
5. Weekly pulse: one row per member each Monday.
Northstar Coaching Circle is a fictional demo community. Member names are placeholders; goals are made up.
Re-engagement loop (added for the hackathon test)

channel: 'none' = draft and review only, never sent. During setup, Fo fills in the tester row(s) with a real name and profile link and sets channel to 'skool'; only those rows can receive a real message.
member_id: the loop's ID for each member. IDs ending in 0 or 5 are the hold-back group and are never contacted.
Touchpoints: the loop adds member_id, channel, direction (out/in), draft_id and replies; 'Last contact' still fills from here.
Status history, Drafts, Conversions, Checks, Scorecard and Run log are written by Fo and Claude. Don't edit them by hand.
